title: 13-Layer Cr-Dielectric Stack with Constrained L-BFGS-B Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 9 to 13 while maintaining Cr-dielectric alternation will recover spectral selectivity performance lost in the 9L reduction, provided thickness bounds prevent non-fabricable ultrathin layers and L-BFGS-B provides stable convergence near the 0.5152 regime.
design_principle: Metal-dielectric multilayer interference with Cr providing visible absorption and dielectric layers (HfO2/SiO2) controlling NIR reflectance through quarter-wave stacking. Admittance locus method guides layer-by-layer optimization.
proposed_topology: Air | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | Al substrate (13 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: minimum 30 nm thickness avoids ultrathin deposition challenges
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric multilayer design
Five-step optimization workflow for optical thin films
expected_advantages: More degrees of freedom than 9L configuration
L-BFGS-B provides stable convergence vs differential evolution
known_risks: Increased layer count may introduce more local minima
Cr absorption may dominate if layers too thick
Score may not recover to 0.6651 baseline
execution_request_english: Optimize a 13-layer planar multilayer stack on Al substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr, HfO2, SiO2, Cr (13 finite layers). All layer thicknesses bounded to [30, 300] nm. Wavelength bands: 400-700 nm (maximize absorptance, minimize reflectance), 700-2000 nm (maximize reflectance). Normal incidence, unpolarized light. Use L-BFGS-B constrained quasi-Newton optimizer with gradient clipping. Initialize thicknesses at 80 nm for Cr layers and 120 nm for dielectric layers. Total layer count constraint: exactly 13 finite layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 9 to 13 to recover performance lost in previous reduction; applied [30, 300] nm thickness bounds per feedback directive; switched from differential evolution to L-BFGS-B optimizer for stable convergence; corrected evidence ID typo
